meta.title-404: Sa myet hna sha ma twe ba | GFTV HelloSpot
meta.description: Fa meit mya hnin fa ri kun bin shin mya dwin lu thit mya meit hswe thit mya hpwe kya thi nay ya. Global Furry Television hma tin hset thi.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: Global Furry Television i taya win wep site
official.line-short: GFTV i taya win wep site
official.domain-heading: GFTV i taya win site mya thi globalfurry.tv tho ma hut gftv.asia hpyin a hsone that thi
official.domain-body: Leit sa ko nauk hsone hma sa hpat ba, pa hta ma hsone tit khu te thaw myin zaung i shay shi nauk hsone a set ko kyi ba. A chya a ya hpyin a hsone that thaw site thi leit sa i a sa paing dwin dho a myi pa nay thaw lei GFTV ma hut ba.
official.trusted-link: GFTV i taya win site mya sa yin a pyi a sone
official.secure-heading: Lone chone thaw site mya thi HTTPS ko a thone pyu thi
official.secure-body: Thaw pone thin gay ta tho ma hut leit sa i a sa dwin https:// ko sha ba. Ko yay a chet a let mya ko lone chone thaw chate hset hmu hpyin taya win site dwin tha hmya way ba.
update.label: Ap deit
update.ready: GFTV HelloSpot ba shin a thit a thint hpyit ba pyi.
update.later: Ya khu ma lote thay ba
hero.card-alt: HelloSpot a myi kat. Kyi ma thaw a pyone bay dwin Hello hnin 哈喽 hu yay hta pyi GFTV i thet tant yaung a sin mya paw dwin shi thi.
hero.title: Thin HelloSpot ta khu ko twe pyi!
hero.lede: Fa meit mya hnin fa ri kun bin shin mya dwin, HelloSpot hso thi hma lu thit mya meit hswe thit mya hpwe kya thi nay ya hpyit thi.
how.title: HelloSpot a lote lote pone
how.spot.title: A pyone ko sha ba
how.spot.body: Kat, lay hswe kyo tho ma hut hsaing boke paw dwin HelloSmile ko sha ba. Yin shi thi nay ya taing thi HelloSpot hpyit thi.
how.hello.title: Hnote hset ba
how.hello.body: La pyi Mingalaba hu hnote hset leit ba. HelloSpot dwin thin ta yauk yauk ko thi pyi tha hpyit ya myi hu myi thu hmya ma hmyaw lint ba.
how.friend.title: Meit hswe hpwe ba
how.friend.body: Thint pat wun kyin shi lu mya hnin twe hsone pyi, nauk ta kyein twe hsone pwe dwin sha hpwe ya myi meit hswe ta yauk hnint a tu pyan thwa ba.
gallery.eyebrow: Ya khin twe hsone pwe mya hma hnote khun hset
gallery.title: HelloSpot mya dwin ya khe thaw meit hswe mya
takagi.when.title: Takagi bae daw lae?
takagi.when.body: Twe hsone pwe taing a hsone that thi myi mei khun.
takagi.now.title: Takagi a khu chet chin!!
takagi.now.body: Kaung pyi, bae daw lae ma mei ne daw.
takagi.eaten.title: Takagi sa pyi pyi.
takagi.eaten.body: Nauk twe hsone pwe a chein tu tu la?
takagi.photos-label: Ya khin twe hsone pwe mya pyi nauk ra man
takagi.photo-1: Ra man ta ban gan hnin khauk hswe a po pa thaw ban, bay dwin Eevee a yote ngay lay ta kaung
takagi.photo-2: Tu hnin hsa lat ngay hna khwet pa thaw Takagi Ramen pa hsay aw da
takagi.photo-3: Ra man, khauk hswe a po, kyet kyaw hnin hsa lat pa thaw ban
takagi.photo-4: Wet tha ra man ta ban gan, gyo za hnin yay khe la hpet yay pa thaw ban
takagi.photo-5: Tu, khauk hswe a po hnin yay khe than pa ya la hpet yay pa thaw ra man ta ban gan
takagi.photo-6: Kaung ta dwin a ni yaung khone pu lay mya shi thaw Takagi Express hsaing myet hna sa
about.eyebrow: Kha na, GFTV hso da ba lae?
about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) thi Sin ga pu dwin a chay saik thaw A sha i a kyi hsone fa ri fan dam tha din chan ne hpyit thi.
about.body-2: Ya nay hnin naung dwin lu taing tan bo hta naing ran fa ri mya i toe tet hmu ko kya nok to pya tha pyi, lu mya a chin chin lay la na le naing ran nay ya mya ko le hpan ti pay ba thi.
about.body-3: A mi nay ya hma taik kyi mya a hti hpyan kyet hta thaw GFTV a hpwe thi naing gan ta ka, yin kyay hmu sone, ba tha za ka sone a hpwe hpyit thi.
